source_semantics.review: Do not adopt this exhaustive-checkNoChanges setup sweep or its local opt-outs into the historical runner. All917 complete case callbacks remain equal, but the global initializer removes its explicitly throwing ErrorHandler and adds exhaustive:true alongside zoneless preparation. Nineteen exhaustive:false calls appear across16 local fixture files, including new pre-fixture TestBed configurations. The owned runner keeps explicit public zoneful preparation, default public fixture stability and zero adopted exhaustive:false exceptions. Complete provider/hook/helper/error source remains distinct: callback equality alone establishes no default-error, initialization, notification, lifecycle or advertised-minimum API/runtime equivalence. Actual supported framework and floor validation remains required.
